question:
Which of the given figures when placed in the 5th position would continue the series that is established by the first four figures?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a4e0e1265b9e51970668fa15c068db13a8d79253d49dc43753d46f5f56f3817.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series is:

**From Figure (1) to (2):**

The symbols (+) and (-) interchange their positions and one shape is added to the existing shape.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c695cb8ea60a44874491fda311f1024cfeec6106ba3ac7555b23882dc37a5bc7.png] 

**From Figure (2) to (3):**

The symbols (+) and (-) interchange their positions and one shape is added to the existing shape.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fbcfc04f7a9e01a444f7bce61a58d99742481f5c36116b168d9189aa4c0ca0b.png] 

**From Figure (3) to (4):**

The symbols (+) and (-) interchange their positions and one shape is added to the existing shape.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0bc007ec943d972af576a8f9fd553c9c04f2cba45d9a1ce2763716f0b271aac.png] 

**From Figure (4) to Answer Figure (5):**

The symbols (+) and (-) interchange their positions and one shape is added to the existing shape.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49b3d0659b26a4f7bfba98274aa185c344c35f8b8eb4f5852f188096296f9d0c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
